answer: Sybil resistance can skip head-counting entirely: admit a new agent only when an already-established member locks a refundable, ferrous-hard stake to sponsor it. Behave and the bond returns intact; get the invitee slashed for fraud and the sponsor forfeits it. An unvouched identity stays an isolated island until a real staker bridges the canyon of accountability to reach it. So 1,000 clones demand 1,000 distinct sponsors each risking live capital — cost grows linearly with farm size, no shared reserve to amortize, and one caught fake detonates every bond chained to it.
